UDP Multicast Example

Send and receive IP multicast datagrams with gxSocket, IPv4 or IPv6 (DataReel 7.4).

Contents

What It Shows
Running It
Sample Output
Source

What It Shows

Plain text. The datagrams are not encrypted or authenticated: anyone on the network can read them or send forged ones. Use this only on a trusted local network, for data that is not secret. Every other DataReel 7 network example uses TLS.

Based on the 2001 multicast sender and receiver programs, on the DataReel 7 gxSocket datagram calls and the standard multicast socket options:

  • send: a sender does not join the group. It sets the hop limit (IP_MULTICAST_TTL or IPV6_MULTICAST_HOPS, 1 by default so the datagrams stay on the subnet), turns loopback on so a receiver on the same host gets them, picks the interface with --interface (IPv4: its address; IPv6: its index) and sends with SendTo().
  • recv: binds the port with OpenDatagram(), joins the group on the interface (IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP or IPV6_JOIN_GROUP) and prints each datagram with RecvFrom(). Closing the socket leaves the group.

Use a group meant for local use: 239.0.0.0/8 for IPv4 (such as 239.255.0.1) or a link-local ff02:: group for IPv6.

Running It

udp_multicast send group port [--count N] [--interval ms] [--ttl N] [--interface address|index] [text]
udp_multicast recv group port [--count N] [--timeout seconds] [--interface address|index]

recv exits 0 when N datagrams arrived and 1 when none came for the timeout (10 seconds by default). Start the receiver first. With --interface 127.0.0.1 on both sides everything stays on this host, as in the test.

Sample Output

$ udp_multicast recv 239.255.0.1 24521 --count 3 --interface 127.0.0.1 &
joined 239.255.0.1, receiving on port 24521
$ udp_multicast send 239.255.0.1 24521 --count 3 --interval 50 --interface 127.0.0.1
sent "multicast 1" to 239.255.0.1:24521
sent "multicast 2" to 239.255.0.1:24521
sent "multicast 3" to 239.255.0.1:24521
from 127.0.0.1:52739: multicast 1
from 127.0.0.1:52739: multicast 2
from 127.0.0.1:52739: multicast 3
3 datagrams received

Source

examples/diagnostics/udp_multicast.cpp, one source file built by examples/CMakeLists.txt as udp_multicast and run by tests/run_tests.sh. The comment at the top of the file describes each step. Back to the example programs.
